Build progress

Daily Marathon

2026-08-06 · wave 4 · claude/effort-estimation-emdxm8
Wave 4 in flight. The course now draws three or four settings per run from a pool of twelve marathon cities, seeded by the date — so every day is a different journey, not just a different layout, and something new arrives roughly every 60 seconds. The renderer is being taught those twelve places now. Landed this wave: the three lanes are three distinct surfaces rather than one flat road, so a hazard's lane can be named from a still frame; ~70% of impassable blocks are now inhabited by a rider or marshals instead of bare barriers; and forced-action gates went from 6% to 38% after the record was called too easy. Outstanding: portrait HUD panels overlap, and the ramp mechanic (vehicles you climb and jump from) is still unbuilt.
